sections.title: 1. Agreement & Eligibility
sections.text: By accessing or using AirPoker, you agree to these terms. You must be of legal age in your jurisdiction to use this service. If you do not agree, please do not use the application.

sections.title: 2. Game Data & Virtual Chips
sections.text: AirPoker provides virtual chips exclusively for tracking live poker games. No real money is handled, processed, or facilitated by the Service. Any financial agreements, side bets, or wagers made between players outside of the application are their sole responsibility. We disclaim all liability regarding offline agreements.

sections.title: 3. Privacy & Accounts
sections.text: AirPoker does not require or store personal data such as emails, passwords, or social logins. Access is completely anonymous. We only use browser Local Storage to keep players connected to their active table and preserve basic preferences.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable Use
sections.text: You agree not to misuse the Service. This includes attempting to disrupt the servers, reverse engineer the platform, or use it to facilitate unlicenced and illegal gambling operations.

sections.title: 5. Availability & "As Is"
sections.text: The Service is provided "as is" without any warranties. We do not guarantee continuous availability and are not responsible for any service interruptions, loss of game data, or table resets due to technical issues, connection drops, or unexpected outages.

sections.title: 6. Limitation of Liability

sections.title: 7. Changes
sections.text: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the Service constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.

about.title: About AirPoker
about.missionText: AirPoker was born to eliminate the frustration of counting, carrying, and splitting physical chips during live poker nights. We believe in the magic of real cards, but the tracking is better left to the machines.
about.howItWorksTitle: How it works in 4 easy steps:
about.step1: 1. Grab a deck of real playing cards.
about.step2: 2. One person creates a table on AirPoker and shares the ID or QR code.
about.step3: 3. Everyone joins from their smartphone—no app downloads and no registration required.
about.step4: 4. Deal the physical cards and let AirPoker do the heavy lifting for tracking bets, raising limits, and splitting the pot.
about.feature1: Forget the chips. Travel light and play anywhere.
about.feature2: Perfect math. No more mistakes splitting tricky pots or calculating all-ins.
about.feature3: Blinds management. Small and Big blinds are posted automatically.
